title: honest baseline bars zero or truncation
rule: Honest baseline: bars start at zero or show truncation. Meaningful scales, consistent time intervals, readable labels. Don’t rotate labels to hide a truncated axis.
pass_when: Bars start at zero, or truncation is shown; scales/intervals are consistent; labels are not rotated to hide a truncated axis.
fail_when: Truncated bar axis with no truncation mark; labels rotated to hide it.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Keep-text-horizontal min px as this baseline row.
